main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-day move on forecast > 0 cases (non-overlapping grid)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper-minus-lower half (by coin's median forecast) mean unusual 3-day move

decided_by: mean unusual 3-day move > 0 with t >= 2 and upper-minus-lower difference > 0.
reading: cases are grid bars (positions 0,3,6,... of each window) with forecast > 0 and a 3-bar return inside the window, the drift is the coin's mean grid 3-bar return over all its windows, the halves split each coin's case forecasts at their median with ties at the median put in the lower half, and the 30-day minimum is treated as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.007486 on the check half (2022 onward) against +0.008783 on every window
